heading: Here’s what happened today
body: We will be closing this live page soon. Here’s a quick recap of the main developments today:

heading: Global economy resilient to war shock but impact lingers, international agencies say
body: The global economy has been “broadly resilient” to the shock from the US-Israel war on Iran, but some effects of the conflict could linger, according to a joint statement from the International Energy Agency, International Monetary Fund, World Bank Group and World Trade Organization.

heading: Firefighter killed in attack on Iranshahr airport: IRNA
body: A firefighter has been killed after an attack on facilities at Iranshahr airport in southeastern Iran, according to Iranian state news agency IRNA.

heading: Oil prices edge higher as US strikes Iran
body: Oil prices have climbed as new US military action against Iran dampens expectations for a swift resolution to the conflict and the subsequent reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, according to the Reuters news agency.

heading: Ghalibaf warns US: ‘Strike, and you will be struck’
body: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has warned the US that “bullying and breaking promises are no longer without cost”.

heading: Air raid sirens sound again in Bahrain
body: Warning sirens are blaring in Bahrain for the second time this morning.

heading: Iran health ministry says 14 killed in US attacks
body: US attacks across five provinces have killed 14 people and injured 78 since they began on Wednesday, Iran’s Health Ministry has said in a statement.

heading: An uneasy night across the Gulf
body: Reporting from Doha, Qatar

heading: US and Iran at a deadlock over Strait of Hormuz
body: Reporting from Tehran, Iran

heading: Gulf states stave off more Iranian attacks
body: Reporting from Doha, Qatar

heading: Explosions heard in Iran’s Bushehr area
body: Several ⁠explosions have been ⁠heard in ⁠Iran’s Bushehr province, the semi-official Mehr ⁠news agency reports.

heading: Iran targets Gulf states to raise costs, increase pressure
body: Reporting from Tehran, Iran

heading: Photos: Ali Khamenei’s funeral procession reaches Mashhad for burial at Imam Reza Shrine
body: Crowds of mourners surround the convoy carrying the coffin of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei before he is buried at the Shrine of Imam Reza, Iran’s most revered place of worship, in Mashhad, Iran, July 9, 2026 [AFP]

heading: Iran warns against further US military ‘adventurism’
body: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warned against any further US military “adventurism” after condemning US attacks on Iran as a violation of the Islamabad memorandum of understanding in a phone call with Pakistan’s army chief, Iran’s Foreign Ministry said.

heading: Iranian FM speaks to Turkish counterpart over ‘ceasefire situation’: Turkish state media
body: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi held a phone conversation with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan this afternoon, according to Turkiye’s TRT.

heading: Israeli army chief says forces on high alert, monitoring Iran and Lebanon
body: Eyal Zamir says the military remains on high alert, with “hundreds of air force aircraft” on immediate standby and tens of thousands of personnel supporting operational readiness.

heading: WATCH: Lebanon Latest – concerns about latest escalation in regional fighting
body: Al Jazeera’s Robert McBride brings you the latest from Beirut with concerns about how renewed fighting in the region will affect Lebanon.

heading: UNIFIL highlights decrease in violence in Lebanon but says situation remains ‘fragile’
body: The UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) said on Thursday that the security situation in southern Lebanon remains “fragile” despite a decrease in violence since late June.

heading: Explosions reported around strategic port in southern Iran’s Konarak
body: Reporting from Tehran, Iran

heading: Source of explosion in Bushehr under investigation, governor says
body: The governor of Bushehr confirmed that explosions were heard in Bushehr and Choghadak, according to the IRNA news agency.
